# Design Instructions

## Direction
- User-friendly, modern, and clean.
- Shadcn-like styling with crisp surfaces, subtle borders, and soft shadows.
- Support light and dark mode equally; ensure contrast and readability.

## Typography
- Use readable, modern fonts and clear typographic hierarchy.
- Prefer consistent spacing and sizing scales.

## Color & Surfaces
- Neutral base with muted accents.
- Use elevated surfaces for cards/modals and gentle gradients if needed.
- Avoid noisy backgrounds; keep layouts calm and focused.

## Components
- Buttons: primary, secondary, ghost, and destructive variants.
- Inputs: clear focus states and error messaging.
- Cards: defined boundaries and consistent padding.

## Interaction
- Use subtle hover and focus states.
- Avoid excessive motion; keep transitions short and purposeful.
